recommendations.text: Monitor pest activity, particularly fall armyworm, which has been reported as high severity. Adjust planting schedule for the second sorghum plot to avoid dry conditions. Keep an eye on market trends and consider selling when prices are favorable. Consider irrigation for the first sorghum plot.
